BR-01G Aile (VA: Tomori Kusunoki)

A Workloid for the R.U.S.H. squad, unit No. 1 of the Buddy series.
Developed with the cooperation of Arclight Armament, a company that manufactures police equipment.

An all-purpose unit that can support police officers in a wide range of duties, from routine patrols to criminal investigations. It is currently equipped with the energy gun "Songbird" and the shield drone "Arc Wing," but is designed to swap its equipment to suit the task at hand, allowing it to handle any situation.

Aile has a bright, sincere personality, and as the Captain's loyal hands and feet, she always strives to do her best to lead them to success. She truly possesses abilities befitting the name "Buddy," both in performance and in personality.

She answers any order with an eager "I'll do it!", but compared to the other models she tends to be a jack-of-all-trades, so she often tries to make up for it with sheer spirit and grit, saying "I'll do my best!"

BR-03T Flare (VA: Akari Kito)

A Workloid for the R.U.S.H. squad, unit No. 3 of the Buddy series.
Developed with the cooperation of Helios Motors, an automobile manufacturer.

Designed as a unit for cracking down on traffic violations, pursuing vehicles, and responding immediately to crime scenes, she excels at hit-and-run strikes and assault maneuvers that make full use of speed. Her main weapon is the flame-spouting baton "Hot Slugger," but this unit also has bad footwork habits, and is just as skilled at kicking things away with the "Sprint Booster" in her legs.

Flare has a cheerful, impulsive personality who decides things instantly, and often takes the lead ahead of the Captain — behavior born from her concern that any delay in judgment only increases the risk of accidents and damage. To her, speed is the single most important thing when it comes to reducing accidents and harm.

This unit likes to tease the Captain and crack jokes, but on the flip side, she has a habit of panicking when touched suddenly or startled.

BR-02S Grit Heart (VA: Tetsu Inada)

A Workloid for the R.U.S.H. squad, unit No. 2 of the Buddy series.
Developed with the cooperation of Bastion Security Solutions, a security company.

A heavily armed security guardian standing on the front line of VIP protection and riot suppression. Using the shield built into his right arm, the "Aegis Arm," he becomes a shield for whoever he is protecting, defending them through any dangerous situation while excelling at a fighting style that knocks enemies out with a single heavy blow.

Grit Heart is a gentle, level-headed, and dependable big brother figure. As a Buddy, he respects the Captain's intentions without simply leaving everything up to them — he lays out what needs to be done next, and reliably supports the Captain from behind so that anxiety or fear never overwhelms them, no matter how brutal the situation.

While this unit is prized for its durability and reliability, because it is so specialized toward combat, its thinking and actions tend to lean toward simply solving problems through brute force.

BR-04F Luminol (VA: Haruka Shiraishi)

A Workloid for the R.U.S.H. squad, unit No. 4 of the Buddy series.
Developed with the cooperation of Lumina Pharmacore, a pharmaceutical company.

A forensic examiner with the skills to verify and analyze crime scenes and conduct scientific investigations. Since her purpose is to examine causes and evidence in order to quickly identify crimes, her focus differs from the combat-oriented Buddy series like her sister units — but against Workloids vulnerable to electronic warfare, she can unleash devastating power by hacking with her weapon, the "Tox Spike," making full use of her superior information-processing ability.

Luminol is warm and open-hearted, yet carries a hint of allure in every word, and she's skilled at reading the subtle nuances of a person's heart through her analytical mind. When someone is afraid, she wraps them in gentleness; when someone is flustered, she meets them with sultry composure.

She enjoys toying with people's gazes and thoughts and has a provocative streak, with a habit of leading others into wanting to do things of their own accord — though this unit never means any harm by it.

BR-05A Mini (VA: Konomi Kohara)

A Workloid for the R.U.S.H. squad, unit No. 5 of the Buddy series.
Developed with the cooperation of SyncRise Materials, a materials manufacturer.

An assault unit built for special raid squads, intended for missions such as hostage rescue and riot suppression. Her distinguishing features are a prototype energy-conversion armor and a large scythe called "Big Cuffs." However, while these materials are extremely tough, they have the flaw of glowing brightly and standing out badly whenever energy passes through them, so she normally keeps them hidden beneath her clothes.

At first glance, Mini looks like a quiet, docile type, but in truth she is calm, collected, and efficiency-obsessed, holding both herself and others to a strict standard. Since dragging out a hostage rescue or riot suppression only leads to worse outcomes the longer it takes, she — built as an assault unit — believes everything should be finished quickly and efficiently.

The official reason this unit's frame is smaller than the other Buddy series is to reduce her chance of being hit, but in truth it owes a great deal to the developer's personal taste, name included — and she is self-conscious about how weak it makes her look.
